title: Chromatic symmetric functions of claw-free graphs are not Schur positive
summary: Chromatic symmetric functions are well-studied symmetric functions in algebraic combinatorics that generalize chromatic polynomials of graphs. In 1995, Stanley introduced these symmetric functions and conjectured that they are Schur positive for claw-free graphs. We give examples of a line graphs, which are thus claw-free, whose chromatic symmetric function have a negative coefficient in its Schur expansion.
